text:
alex: Heads up — seeing a P95 spike for eu-prod around 22:18 UTC, started ~22:12. Affected request path /v1/gen. Suggest we gate the release queue for EU and cool down deployments for 30m. @sam_ops can you confirm root cause?

deploybot: ACTION: release-queue PAUSED by alex at 3359998888. Scope: region=eu, windows=next-release-slot. Reason: latency spike on eu-prod. Hold ID: hb-3359.

sam_ops: looking into it now. Failover to standby cluster in progress, running db connection drain and rolling k8s node cordon. ETA 20m-30m. No 5xx spike but qps pattern changed.

maya: thanks. @alex @sam_ops — let's not trigger a rollback immediately. Plan: 1) pin current canary (v3.2.1) for observability; 2) defer next EU release window by 12 hours, 3) update release notes and customer-facing blurb. If root cause persists past 30m we escalate rollback.

taylor: quick q — which version would we roll back to if needed? last prod tag is v3.2.0. Rollback playbook ready in /docs/runbooks/rollback.md.

alex: agreed. I'll pin canary with a tag and block new deploy slots: `./scripts/pin_release.sh --region eu --version v3.2.1 --reason "post-incident gate"` 

maya: deploybot — can you schedule a deferred slot? Command: `/requeue --window "eu-night" --new-start 2026-03-22T09:00Z --note "deferred after eu-prod latency spike"`

deploybot: OK — requeue accepted. Old slot eu-night (2026-03-21T21:00Z) -> new start 2026-03-22T09:00Z. Notified: #customers-notify if release notes updated.

sam_ops: failover completed, latency trending down but still ~10% above baseline. I'm keeping the cordoned nodes offline until metrics stable. Monitoring for 15m.

maya: I'll patch release notes: minimal customer-facing text. Draft: "We've deferred the EU release window and pinned the canary to v3.2.1 while we investigate a transient latency issue in eu-prod. No customer action required. We'll replay the rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC if metrics normalize."

taylor: thanks. If metrics are stable in 30m, do we unpause the queue or do a staggered resume?

maya: staggered resume only — canary -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> full. Ops will verify each step. Add a canary check step: `monitoring.check("eu-p95", threshold=1.2*baseline, duration=5m)` after each step.

alex: noted. I'll open an internal postmortem stub and attach timeline + deploy logs. ID: PM-3359.

deploybot: REMINDER: hold hb-3359 expires 3359999088 unless extended. Use `/hold extend hb-3359 --minutes 30` to extend.

maya: extending for 30m given slow tail. `/hold extend hb-3359 --minutes 30` done.

sam_ops: current status: mitigations applied, p95 ~6% over baseline. Will report in 15m.

maya: good. I'll coordinate release-notes and customer comms with growth. Will reconvene here after the 15m check. :thumbsup:
